title: Ubiquiti UniFi UAP-AC-PRO 1750Mbps Dual-Band AC Pro Access Point

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Ubiquiti UniFi UAP-AC-PRO – 1750Mbps Dual-Band Gigabit WiFi Access Point

The Ubiquiti UniFi UAP-AC-PRO is a high-performance dual-band WiFi access point, delivering up to 1750Mbps combined speed for seamless, ultra-fast wireless connectivity. Designed for businesses, offices, hotels, cafes, and large homes, this enterprise-grade access point ensures reliable coverage with MU-MIMO technology and Gigabit Ethernet support.

Key Features:

  • Blazing-Fast 1750Mbps WiFi Speed – Dual-band connectivity with 450Mbps (2.4GHz) + 1300Mbps (5GHz)
  • Advanced MU-MIMO & Beamforming – Enhanced performance in high-density environments
  • Scalable UniFi Network Integration – Seamless control via the UniFi Network Application
  • Weather-Resistant Design – Suitable for indoor and outdoor deployments
  • Dual Gigabit Ethernet Ports – Faster, more reliable wired connections
  • Powered by 802.3af/802.3at PoE – Simplified installation with Power over Ethernet


Upgrade to Ubiquiti UniFi UAP-AC-PRO for lightning-fast, stable, and scalable WiFi connectivity.
